title: Low-degree Fourier estimator program
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, and a rational parameter $\varepsilon$ with $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$, the low-degree Fourier estimator is a random-example learning program that outputs a sparse Fourier hypothesis in dimension $n$, using the family of all subsets of the $n$ coordinates of size at most $k$.
